definitions.source_event_count: Transaction/activity rows only, including pending; excludes printed headers, totals, and footers.
definitions.spending_draft_count: Posted purchases, fees and interest only; refunds, income, transfers, cash withdrawals, card payments and pending rows excluded.
definitions.signed_amount_cents: Negative is money out / charge; positive is money in / payment credit. Liability closing = opening - signed movements.
definitions.budget_items: Current financial setup proposals only; archive estimates and monthly schedules are supporting evidence, not duplicate items. Faithful optional profile notes are not counted as financial items.
definitions.identifiers: event_id is a fixture join key, not an application deduplication contract.
